sources.title: Immigration and visas
sources.publisher: Embassy of Panama in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Panama's live official Embassy consular page expressly includes Ghana in its stamped-visa cohort and describes consular approval and passport stamping before travel.

policies.title: Ghanaian ordinary passports: Panama stamped visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Ghana in its stamped-visa cohort, requiring consular processing and passport stamping before travel unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Ghanaian passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Submit the listed stamped-visa documents before travel; approval may take up to 30 business days and, if granted, the applicant must appear personally for passport stamping.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy stamped-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 30 business days, depending on document verification.
steps: Determine that the separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed stamped-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
If granted, appear personally at the consulate to have the visa stamped in the passport.
